completeness_basis: Fetched the live public Artificial Analysis page and decrypted its AES-GCM/gzip data manifests using the page-provided public key material. The source page reported 618 models and 24 evaluations; the model manifest contained all 618 models. The issue-time baseline was 616 models, so the live source changed by +2 to 618 and that difference is explicitly reported in limitations. Every non-null score component for the 24 required evaluation ids was emitted from the source model records, with GDPval raw Elo and source normalized values, AA-Omniscience accuracy and derived non-hallucination kept distinct, AA-Briefcase Elo left unnormalized, and different benchmark versions kept separate.
limitations: The public source did not expose evaluated_at timestamps for these rows; evaluated_at is left empty rather than substituted with model release date.
The source model total changed from the issue-time baseline of 616 to 618 at crawl time (+2); the live value is recorded and the difference is named here.
The source manifests did not expose explicit rank fields; source_rank is reproducibly derived by descending source score, with source model id as the deterministic tie-breaker.
The source parameter field is published in billions; models.csv converts it to an integer parameter count by multiplying by 1,000,000,000.
